title: Pidhirtsi Castle

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 follows retained standard viewer DEM387.1541m at anchor. Estimated3.5m court/palace datum clears the coarse courtyard ground; foundations follow slopes, and outside causeway joins approach ground approximately. This is not a bare-earth or moat survey.

note: Exact-QID main outline and current palace polygon plus north-garden/south-entry paths establish approximate scale and signed facing. Outer ramparts, architectural heights, stairs and roof profiles remain estimates. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
